edges.description: Reduced Jagged1 dosage weakens developmental cell-cell Notch signaling around portal vessels.
Impaired Notch signaling perturbs cardiac and vascular morphogenesis.
Pathogenic NOTCH2 variants are expected to impair the receptor arm of the same developmental signaling axis, although their exact molecular effects vary.
Reduced portal vascular Jagged1-Notch signaling impairs cholangiocyte differentiation and duct assembly.
Bile duct paucity causes impaired bile flow and chronic cholestasis.

edges.target: Reduced number of intrahepatic bile ducts

edges.description: Chronic cholestasis drives severe itching and symptomatic burden.
Retention of cholesterol-rich lipids in severe cholestasis promotes cutaneous xanthomas.
Progressive liver injury can culminate in clinically evident portal hypertension.
Cholestatic malabsorption and fat-soluble vitamin deficiency impair growth.
Chronic cholestatic malnutrition and growth impairment can delay pubertal development.
Systemic developmental arteriopathy includes stenosis of the renal arteries.
Renal arterial stenosis can produce renovascular hypertension.
